verdict.rationale: Retell documents official Node.js and Python SDKs. They are typed clients with API key auth, structured errors, full TypeScript support, and claimed full coverage of the voice and chat endpoints. That clearly delivers the ability to build against official SDKs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality and coverage, and SDKs for languages beyond Node.js and Python.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Retell provides official SDKs for Node.js and Python to simplify integration with our platform.
Typed clients with API key auth, structured errors, and full voice and chat endpoint coverage.
Type safety: Full TypeScript support with autocomplete
